description: Your chat. Your rules. — Cleans up Hypixel chat (SkyBlock + lobbies): 60+ compact formats, per-message control, chat tabs, Ctrl+F search, your colors. Nothing deleted behind your back.

mods.name: Hypixel Simple Chat
mods.description: Reformats Hypixel chat (lobbies + SkyBlock) into a clean, readable version — nothing lost. Commands: /hsc (or /gz, /hypixelsimplechat), /hsc update

releases.notes:
## Minecraft compatibility
Supports **Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3 only**.

## Added
- **Weather alerts** setting to compact, dim, or hide Professor Wynd’s automatic weather reports.
- Compact weather alerts keep the weather type, location, and original colors while removing the automatic introduction.

## Chat and history fixes
- SkyBlock XP gains now remain separate instead of merging into misleading repeat counts.
- Reward lines stay in their original announcements instead of disappearing or moving when repeated.
- Fixed SkyBlock XP compaction when a message contains progress without a milestone name.
- Collection separators are no longer mistaken for chest reward separators.
- Fixed channel filtering for reformatted messages and separated outgoing channel routing from display filtering.
- Improved player message detection when multiple emblems appear before a username.
- Fixed the global toggle so disabling the mod leaves incoming messages unchanged.
- Improved preservation of clickable chat buttons and formatted text in custom highlights.

## Reward summaries
- Safari and chest summaries now appear from the first reward and update as rewards arrive. Interrupted summaries keep rewards already displayed.
- Fixed **Compact Grey** mode displaying colored Safari and chest summaries.
- Fixed Hoppity rabbit discoveries appearing alongside their compact summaries.
- Fixed leftover Safari separators and summaries swallowing unrelated messages.

## Other improvements
- Fixed update checks treating beta and stable versions as identical.
- Invalid version numbers no longer report “up to date.”
- Expanded `/hsc debug` logging to track incoming, hidden, and displayed messages.

## Removed
- Removed the **Preset** row and **Default / Recommended** buttons.
- Removed automatic application of the Recommended preset on first launch.

**Existing settings are preserved.** New installations use the standard default settings.
